config.packageCache.useFhirHome: Read from and write to the shared `~/.fhir/packages` cache, so the IG Publisher, Sushi and this extension reuse each other's downloads.
config.registry.sources: Registries searched for packages, in order. No single registry has every version: `packages2.fhir.org` publishes each version's `dependencies` but mirrors only a slice of what publishers released, while `packages.simplifier.net` keeps the full history and has its dependencies read out of the package archive instead.
config.registry.sources.url: Registry serving npm-style package metadata at `/{id}`.
config.registry.sources.searchUrl: Registry serving `/catalog?op=find` for package search. Optional: a registry without one simply contributes no search results.
config.terminologyServer.url: Optional terminology server used to `$expand` value sets that the imported packages cannot expand. Leave empty to disable.
